what: The hand-lettered signature SVG strokes are drawn one after another over 2 seconds like a video (each stroke in its assigned time slot, with no easing curve). It reacts only at the moment of crossing contact with the very bottom of the page (bottom edge within the screen bottom + 4px). The header signature (reverse-at-bottom) is erased backward at 1.15x speed from the fully drawn picture when it touches the bottom, and is drawn again from the start when it leaves the bottom. The footer signature (on: bottom) is drawn when it touches the bottom and erased backward when it leaves. With loop it repeats endlessly like a loading indicator.

options.on: “load” (default, draws as soon as attached) · “visible” (draws once when it enters the screen) · “bottom” (draws when it reaches the very bottom and erases in reverse when leaving) · “event” (waits for the fx:play event)
options.dur: Total length (sec), default 2 — length of the original signature video
options.reverse-at-bottom: If 1, it erases in reverse when it reaches the bottom, and redraws from the start when it leaves (header signature)
options.speed: Reverse-erase speed, default 1 — original head signature 1.15
options.loop: If 1, loops endlessly from the start when it ends (load-more indicator)
options.[data-fx-part=stroke]: Stroke to draw (path) — pathLength="1" Attach it. The time cell uses data-at="0 1.35"(sec) — if absent, split evenly by stroke count. Curve per stroke is data-ease="0.4,0,0.2,1"(If none, ease option)
options.fx:play / fx:reverse: Fire this event on an element to draw from the start / erase backward from where it was fully drawn (used e.g. to draw when a heading appears)
options.ease: Curve for all strokes — a css name (ease, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out, linear) or “x1,y1,x2,y2”, no default curve

use: <svg data-fx="sign-draw" data-fx-sign-draw="reverse-at-bottom: 1; speed: 1.15" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><path data-fx-part="stroke" data-at="0 1.35" pathLength="1" d="…"/><path data-fx-part="stroke" data-at="1.35 1.85" pathLength="1" d="…"/></svg>
note: The original scrubs the currentTime of the signature video (webm, mp4) back and forth. The part gives the same length and the same forward and backward behaviour with an SVG line draw (stroke-dashoffset)

from.where: shared.js Mark — header signature (on the first page it draws once the header appears past 40% of the screen, on other pages it draws on open, rewinds at 1.15x speed at the very bottom) · two footer signatures (draw at the very bottom, rewind on leaving) · load-more indicator for the work list (loop) — original useVideoBottom·lamMark 2-second video
